Lena M.: Quick sync — CurrencyFlow POC. They want streaming SDK + function calls to attach FX rates (structured JSON) to each txn. VPC + SAML, 30d retention. Need a tiny Node or Go sample and hosted vs reserved pricing. Timeline 3w.

Ravi S.: Do they need HSM KMS or is cloud KMS ok? Also confirm egress allowed for fx service.

Lena M.: They prefer HSM but will confirm. Egress allowed with IP allowlist.

Owen T.: Short Node snippet for streaming + func call (pseudo):
```js
const s = client.stream({model:'redwood-infer-pro-v1',functions:[{name:'fx',parameters:{type:'object'}}],function_call:'auto'});
for await (evt of s) if(evt.type==='function_call') handle(JSON.parse(evt.payload));
```

Owen T.: Note: include JSON schema in functions.parameters to avoid hallucinated fields. Use quantized variant for Private if cost is a concern.

BillingBot: Estimating: hosted ~ $0.02/1k tokens => 1M tokens ≈ $20/mo. Reserved for 500 qps profile ≈ $8k-$10k/mo depending on latency SLOs. Expedited onboarding + one-off setup fees extra.

SecurityBot: Uploaded sec questionnaire and SAML attribute map link. IP allowlist template: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/ip-allowlist-template.md

Ravi S.: Action items: 1) Lena request IDP metadata + KMS decision; 2) Owen prep tiny demo with schema; 3) Billing produce hosted vs 3mo reserved quote.

Lena M.: I'll email them now with asks. Will loop back here with replies. Thanks. :thumbsup:
